records.title: Compute Infrastructure
records.description: Record runtime inputs and versions. Define which operations require exact results and which permit rounding.

records.title: Data Pipelines
records.description: Preserve original input and link each parsed item back to its source position.

records.title: Neural Networks
records.description: Keep entities in individually addressable records. Verify proposed changes before accepting them.

records.title: Embeddings & Vector Space
records.description: Use similarity to discover relationships. Use explicit identifiers to resolve which record is which.

records.title: Reinforcement Learning (RL)
records.description: Record feedback with the proposed update and apply consistency rules before committing a change.

records.title: Tokenization
records.description: Preserve original characters and positions. Map model tokens back to their source characters.

records.title: Transformer Architecture & Attention
records.description: Track relationships across positions while retaining distinct source references.

records.title: Pre-Training & Scaling Laws
records.description: Preserve authored axioms in their original form. Version executable operators separately.

records.title: Post-Training & Alignment (RLHF)
records.description: Check proposed claims against the rules and verified records for their scope.

records.title: Multimodality
records.description: Preserve originals in each format and explicitly record cross-format links.

records.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
records.description: Resolve canonical identifiers by exact match. Keep assertions linked to the sources that supplied them.

records.title: Memory Systems
records.description: Retain prior versions. Record evidence, date, and the version superseded by a correction.

records.title: Tool Use & Protocols (MCP)
records.description: Resolve each command to a tool, target, and arguments. Record the observed outcome.

records.title: Guardrails & Evaluation
records.description: Check accepted claims within their scope. Preserve competing evidence without accepting incompatible claims in the same scope.

records.title: System-2 Reasoning & Planning
records.description: Connect each reasoning step to its premises and the rule used to derive it.

records.title: World Models & Causal Reasoning
records.description: Give entities and events persistent identities. Track time, scope, state, and evidence.

records.title: Embodiment & Continual Learning
records.description: Record new observations with their sources and run consistency checks before changing accepted state.
